name: – Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz – § 16 – Am 11
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 16. Acknowledges Mexico’s commitment to strategies and national development plans that take into account environmental protection, social inclusion and economic diversification; welcomes the role of the Agreement in promoting the sustainable management of fisheries and forests and combating illegal fishing and logging activities;
